connect.title: Connect Speaker
connect.description: Connect to an LG Music Flow soundbar or speaker on your local network. (If the speaker is on another VLAN, ensure TCP port 9741 is allowed).

wizard_menu.title: Reset & Wi-Fi Setup Wizard
wizard_menu.description: If your speaker is not found across your VLANs, or has lost its Wi-Fi configuration, choose how you'd like to set it up:

menu_options.wizard_ethernet: Option 1: Setup via temporary Ethernet cable (Directly inside Home Assistant)
menu_options.wizard_hotspot_guide: Option 2: Setup via Wi-Fi hotspot (From your laptop or PC)

wizard_ethernet.title: Option 1: Ethernet-Assisted Wi-Fi Setup
wizard_ethernet.description:
1. Ensure the speaker is powered ON.
2. Press and hold the **Wi-Fi / Add** button on the back/remote for 5–10 seconds until the LED flashes.
3. Plug an Ethernet cable into the speaker and your router or switch temporarily.
4. Enter the speaker's IP and your home 2.4GHz Wi-Fi details below. Home Assistant will configure the speaker and add it immediately.

wizard_hotspot_guide.title: Option 2: Wi-Fi Hotspot Setup (From Laptop/PC)
wizard_hotspot_guide.description:
Home Assistant runs as a home server and does not disconnect or change its own Wi-Fi. To configure the speaker using its temporary setup hotspot, use any laptop or PC:

1. Ensure the speaker is powered ON.
2. Press and hold the **Wi-Fi / Add** button on the back/remote for 5–10 seconds until the LED flashes white/amber.
3. On your laptop or PC, connect your Wi-Fi to the network named **MusicFlow_Setup_xxxx**.
4. Run the setup tool provided with this integration:
   `node setup_soundbar_wifi.js`
5. Follow the terminal prompts to send your home Wi-Fi credentials.
6. Once configured, reconnect your laptop to your home network. Home Assistant will automatically discover the speaker!
